descriptions.notStarted: There's apparently a mysterious dolphin in the corridors of the  Nautilus' lower deck. Seems very strange... What would a dolphin be doing out of the water and onboard a ship?
descriptions.inProgress: The mysterious dolphin is claiming that he is actually a Whalian prince and  that he can't transform back to being a Prince because he is low on mana. Perhaps I should go find a bottle of #bmana elixir#k for the Whalian Prince?
descriptions.completed: Finally, the Whalian Prince has been replenished with mana. I thought he was just an ordinary dolphin... I mean, who would have known that he could turn out to be such a handsome prince?
